description: This file is a server entry point for a Remix application, handling incoming HTTP requests and streaming responses based on whether the requester is a bot or a browser.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main function that processes incoming requests and dispatches them based on the request method, handling both bot and browser requests.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles requests coming from bots, rendering the response using server-side streaming.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles requests coming from browsers, rendering the response using server-side streaming.
